source: official Copilot June3-7 selected session partitions
models: 3 HGB q90 using unchanged PARAMS and eleven causal relative-call features
target: max current5min call count through ready bin, delays1/2/6
baseline: train weighted relative peak q90, past hour max/q90/mean; select by validation pinball only
gate: test loss reduction>=5% vs validation selected baseline, coverage85..95%; exploratory only
source_identity: count all call occurrences; reject repeated session IDs; message_id reused and never used to deduplicate
comparison: frozen v1 models scored on same full five-partition time series; extra earlier sessions may contribute later calls, so not isolated training-duration effect
scope: sampled LLM call arrivals, no prompt token, GPU capacity, VM count or action effect
